name: Parallel Projected Tetrahedra with KD-Tree Partitioning
aliases: Parallel Unstructured Volume Rendering in ParaView
definition: A parallel rendering approach for unstructured grids that divides data by a kd-tree to allow the application of a traditional sort-last compositing algorithm, rendering unstructured grids natively without sampling into a regular grid.
summary: Parallel Projected Tetrahedra with KD-Tree Partitioning enables parallel volume rendering of unstructured grids by partitioning data with a kd-tree and compositing images, avoiding grid-based sampling and continuous cell transfer.
